def problem(x: np.ndarray) -> float:

    A synthetic benchmark function combining a rotated elliptic function with a sum of cosines and a constraint term.
    This introduces ill-conditioning due to the rotated elliptic, ruggedness from the cosine sum,

    R = np.eye(n)
    for i in range(n):

            R[j, j] = np.cos(theta)
            R[i, j] = -np.sin(theta)
